merge_gate.local_full_validation_scope: Firmware/host/tests/tools source unchanged between this commit and merged main; Git tree verification retained separately.

source.scope: Firmware and host implementation; the later diagnostic collection tool patch is identified separately.

reader.page_effect: default/off; global settings did not set page_effect

conditions.cache: Final firmware nine-group preparation, then separately measured warm persistent cache; final phase is not cold media. Prior v4 first rebuild on intermediate 9c373f7 retained separately. PPCOVER3 rebuilt before scoring. Full-page indexing may differ from prior v4; per-action stable page-count matching is reported separately, without forcing optional work or transplanting old caches.
conditions.timing: host monotonic command send to confirmed driver frame; not optical or physical input delay

retention_evidence.scope: All ten repeated boundary commands in each of nine scored groups, including full-clean final frames. Read records are taken only from log events within each sample_start/sample_end host interval.

telemetry_semantics.cache_chapter: Bytes of the completed but not yet adopted adjacent Chapter prefetch result (CacheUsage.next_chapter); excludes current/recent serialized content caches.
telemetry_semantics.cache_total: Includes current/recent serialized content-cache capacities and other measured optional payloads; not total heap usage or an allocation peak.
telemetry_semantics.retained_hit: Explicit chapter_cache read=hit retained=1 record; reuse still validates payload digest and records.
telemetry_semantics.missing_read_record: No cache read log was observed in this action window; the cache path is not inferred.

limitations: Read counters below describe observed cache log records, not CPU utilization or panel optical quality.
Unknown cache contents, page-index state, other optional work, logging and sequential-run effects remain comparison confounders.
A retained hit proves reuse in these action windows; it does not establish a causal end-to-end latency gain.
Resource values are before/after status samples during repeated turns, not instantaneous allocation peaks.

tail_observation.scope: A background pagination operation overlapped this action. Its full duration is not cancellation latency; cancellation request time and detailed I/O spans were not captured, so the 83.443 ms increase cannot be attributed to it alone.

history.scope: Common labelled actions with non-clearing final frames in both runs; repeated boundaries and pages without foreground chapter jobs; diagnostic USB host-to-driver elapsed time.
limitations: The page-index-matched subset additionally requires equal and stable reported total-page values before and after each action. It does not prove equal active background work or cache contents. count=counting is a status label, not proof of an active pagination worker.

Old pagination-v4 caches were invalidated by v5. Natural preparation does not guarantee complete indexing under memory admission limits; completed-index versus unknown-index actions remain only in the broader table.
Current persistent caches are retained; first open and cold boundary timings are not comparable.
Current workload starts each group with K2 and repositions using K1; automatic full-clean cadence differs and mismatched full frames are excluded.
Book bytes are rechecked separately; semantic positions use source anchors; CRC includes changing footer counters and battery/time.
Sequential historical runs, not randomized A/B; small-sample P99 is often the maximum.

creengine.scope: Per-profile observations are not distinct source positions. Explicitly unsupported long source node splits remain unsupported; exit status zero is not complete KOReader-client acceptance.

article_parse.source: Existing local article backups; freshly rechecked with main-linked chapter_stream_probe, not every file rehashed from the device in this batch.

independent_html_matrix.scope: Original 55 matrix and later targeted rechecks are separate runs; full final CTest covers final tracked regressions.

collection_incidents.cause: Saved-anchor comparison before deferred save completed; not a firmware failure.
collection_incidents.correction: Durable comparisons for article end detection; TXT minimum traversal uses confirmed frames and actual cross-part adoption.

collection_incidents.cause: At book end the existing forward action opens tools; the collector incorrectly waited for reading.
collection_incidents.correction: Accept and record the expected EOF tools transition, dismiss to reading and verify durable position.

collection_incidents.cause: A prefetch hit is not required for an actual foreground part transition. The collector asserted the wrong proxy.
collection_incidents.correction: Validated 400 confirmed forward frames and foreground part 1/2 transitions in complete trace; independently matched the durable endpoint and ran 400 reverse commands, reopen and source verification in content-device-resume/.

collection_incidents.cause: Collector returned to library without waiting for LibraryCovers to complete.
collection_incidents.correction: Wait for idle state, cover readiness and no open operations; rerun portal and reboot spans.

collection_incidents.cause: Long canvas export did not service the bounded trace recorder while background TXT pagination emitted events.
collection_incidents.correction: Service diagnostic trace between canvas chunks, preserving frame identity and CRC validation. Rerun affected portal/reboot spans, then validate final unconditional callback with in-memory trace disabled.

limitations: Path-only inline SVG and independent SVG files remain unsupported image sources; explicitly classified image/patch failures are retained, not counted as image success.

Gray/old text in user photo persists while stopped and clears after full refresh. BSP white maintenance defect fixed; no matched camera optical acceptance, so visible residual not declared verified resolved.
C041 OPF is invalid and its source body is a fetch-failure message; re-export required, not replaced by empty or invented article.
Device corpus open and targeted page walks do not prove every page/image of every book.
No actual KOReader client roundtrip, OTA slot switching, physical power cut/card swap/slow card, power current or physical touch acceptance.
Actual 404 HTTP response and SDK loop fault probes are separate evidence; no real TLS transport fault injection.
Historical sequential runs are not randomized AB; exact matched action/cache/refresh subsets and tails are retained.

portal_reboot_trace_recheck.scope: Chunk callback active because these sessions retained in-memory trace; conditional variant preserved exactly.
